newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific Nickel in nickel ore supply pact.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Nickel in nickel ore supply pact.

text.p: Pacific Nickel Ltd said on Tuesday its Philnico Mining & Industrial Corp subsidiary, which controls the Nonoc nickel refinery project in the Philippines, has agreed to buy up to one million dry tonnes of ore a year for 10 years from Hinatuan Mining Corp.
Pricing of the ore will depend on its nickel and cobalt content, Pacific Nickel said.
Pacific Nickel currently holds an option to acquire Pacific Nickel Holdings Ltd, which together with a Philippine affiliate, owns Philnico.
Hinatuan will supply the ore from two islands near the Nonoc refinery, Pacific Nickel said.

The Hinatuan ore, when blended with Nonoc's own ore, is expected to provide a higher feed grade of 1.4 percent nickel to the refinery and enable production of about 38,000 tonnes of nickel a year, Pacific Nickel said.
Nonoc has been closed since 1986 after falling victim to high local currency exchange rates and low metal prices.
The Philippine government entered into an agreement with Pacific Nickel, formerly Arboyne NL, in July 1996 to take over the project.
The refinery also is forecast to produce about 1,500 tonnes of cobalt annually.
